controls.name: FieldList
controls.purpose: A titled list of label and value rows. The Blazor component renders the pk-field-list element and slots its Field rows into it.
controls.mobile: Rows stack below 640px; a flyout on a phone sizes the label to its text through --pk-field-list-columns.
controls.accessibility: A real description list; the heading names the section.

controls.name: Field
controls.purpose: One label and value row of a field list: a dt and dd pair that skips itself when the value is empty. The list is the pk-field-list element.
controls.mobile: Pairs stack below 640px, as the list does.
controls.accessibility: A real description list term and definition.
